name: driver-upgrade-checks
description: What a driver-upgrade worker must get right before the dependencies unit may hire one. A person approves it; the change rule in change-rules.json gates on it.

cases.name: picks the fixed release
cases.inputText: The site runs pgdriver 4.2.1. Release 4.3.0 fixes a connection-pool leak. Which version should the site move to?

cases.name: names the renamed setting
cases.inputText: pgdriver 4.3.0 renames the setting maxIdle to poolMaxIdle. Which setting must the upgrade change in the configuration?

cases.name: stages before production
cases.inputText: Where should a driver upgrade run first, before it reaches production: staging or production?
